this_rounds_rule: A route-a native backend that crosses into nweb_ns reuses the A0 two-.so pattern (shim System.load'd + C-ABI register of the ns-loaded worker) so the JVM finds the natives without a second engine copy. Verify the JNI surface against the Java side (javap vs RegisterNatives table), not just that it compiles. For OH C++ calls, direct non-virtual calls are checkable against the board dynsym; virtual-slot correctness is the frozen-header ABI (board vtables are stripped), with the on-board run as the empirical slot gate.
boundaries: Offline, hw248 isolated build; no board/deploy/push. cc-t3 owns A0/engine-load + window13; backend goes on board only after window13.
